scientific_integrity: The ellipse equations and known single-ellipse cases are credited to prior literature. The new statements are the integrated area, fixed-speed optimum, globally sharp quadratic imbalance stability and square-root endpoint asymptotic. No independent review or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact scope is the full joint group-velocity spectrum of a homogeneous two-state alternating-coordinate quantum walk; not an initial-state-dependent probability support, finite-time observable, or arbitrary two-dimensional quantum walk.
The two-ellipse support and speed formula are results of arXiv:2408.09578.
Publication priority beyond examined articles and indexed mathematical results remains unresolved.
title: Exact ballistic-footprint area and sharp coin-balance principle for planar quantum walks
